title: Sega Saturn de Hakken!! Tamagotchi Park
native_title: セガサターンで発見！！ たまごっちパーク
overview:
"This is the Tamagotchi Park everyone's talking about!"

"It's sooo beautiful!"

Raise Tamagotchi in a park full of virtual pets. Look after your Tamagotchi as the seasons change around the raising screen, cheer them up with colorful mood-boosting games and send them out to compete in contests such as races. Raise generation after generation and build a Tamagotchi family tree.

- Sega characters appear as Tamagotchi you can raise, including Sonictchi, Pengo, Opa-Opa, Alex Kidd and Flicky
- Packaged with a Backup Memory cartridge

ここがウワサのたまごっちパークじゃ

すんごいビューティフルですね〜
